categories.name: Third-Party & Supply Chain
categories.text: Does the activity buy, renew, or rely on an external third party to provide, host, operate, support, maintain, or deliver any part of the service?
categories.help: Anyone outside the company doing part of the work: a software subscription, a cloud provider, a managed service, contractors, or an outsourced team. A renewal counts.

prefill.because: you named a vendor at intake
you told us this is a vendor renewal

categories.name: Solution Architecture
categories.text: Will this activity create, build, deploy, integrate, or materially change an information system, application, or digital service?
categories.help: Building or buying software, connecting two systems together, moving something to a new platform, or changing how an existing system is set up.

equalsAny: Moving a proof of concept into production

prefill.because: moving a proof of concept into production changes a system

categories.name: AI & Model Risk
categories.text: Will this activity use artificial intelligence or machine learning in any product or service — internally built, vendor-embedded, or third-party?
categories.help: Includes AI features inside a product you buy, not only models you build yourself.

prefill.because: you told us at intake that this uses AI or machine learning

categories.name: Data Management & Privacy
categories.text: Will the activity collect, access, store, process, transmit, or share non-public enterprise data?
categories.help: Any information not approved for public release — customer or employee details, internal reports, financial records, credentials.

prefill.because: you classified the data as Internal, Confidential, or Restricted

categories.name: Legal & Regulatory Compliance
categories.text: Does the activity support, enable, or change a process, product, service, or technology capability subject to externally governed compliance obligations?
categories.help: Rules set outside the company that this work has to satisfy — privacy law, financial regulation, records retention, accessibility, advertising standards.

categories.name: Operational Risk
categories.text: Does the activity introduce or materially change an operational process, service delivery, or workflow?
categories.help: A change to how work actually gets done day to day — new steps, new handoffs, new approvals, or a different way of delivering a service.

categories.name: Security & Resilience
categories.text: Does the activity introduce or change any technology component, integration, connectivity, or identity and access pattern?
categories.help: New connections between systems, new ways in from outside, or changes to who can sign in and what they can reach.

categories.name: Governance & Oversight
categories.text: Does the activity create or change accountable ownership, decision rights, oversight responsibilities, or ongoing monitoring?
categories.help: Who owns this, who decides, who approves exceptions, and who watches it once it is running.

categories.name: Ethics & Conduct
categories.text: Could the activity involve or create ethics, conduct, or trust risks — unfair treatment, misleading communications, or harmful outcomes?
categories.help: Anything that could treat people unfairly, mislead them, monitor them beyond what the job needs, or damage trust if it went wrong.

categories.name: People & Capacity
categories.text: Does the activity rely on people, skills, certifications, supervisory capacity, or time-zone coverage in a way that could affect sustainable delivery?
categories.help: Whether delivery depends on scarce skills, specific qualifications, a small number of key people, or coverage across time zones.

categories.name: Jurisdiction-Bound Execution
categories.text: Does the activity rely on jurisdiction-bound execution or client and regulator interaction that constrains where and how the work can be performed?
categories.help: Work that legally has to happen in a particular place, or that involves dealing directly with regulators or clients in a specific market.
